india.one_line: India pushes AI policy and adoption as firms and government move on agents, speech tech, and oversight.

themes.title: Government moves on AI policy
themes.text: Nasscom has proposed a three-year AI Services Transformation and Innovation Scheme for Budget 2027-28 to help Indian IT firms commercialise AI products, while India called for human oversight in AI use during conflicts at a UN Security Council debate.

stories.headline: Nasscom proposes three-year AI scheme for Indian IT firms in Budget 2027-28
India stresses human oversight in AI use during conflicts at UN

themes.title: AI agents reshape Indian IT
themes.text: A KPMG-CII report finds 93% of Indian business leaders plan to deploy AI agents, with 59% already using them, and a Systematix report says AI adoption will sustain demand for Indian IT services firms even as it pressures traditional labor-based delivery models.

stories.headline: 93% of Indian business leaders plan to adopt AI agents, report says
Systematix report: AI adoption to sustain Indian IT services demand, labor models pressured

themes.title: Indian speech-to-text API launches
themes.text: Sarvam AI has released Sarvam Dictate, a speech-to-text API supporting English and 22 Indian languages at ₹0.50 per minute, which in tests required 40% fewer character edits than Gemini 3.5 Transcribe for English and 47% fewer for Indian languages.

stories.headline: Sarvam AI launches Dictate API for English and 22 Indian languages
